prompts:
Create a production animation sprite sheet based on the attached EXACT character reference. This is the same blue-black bob-haired chibi office woman wearing a blue cardigan with small gold buttons, white shirt, cream loose trousers and white sneakers. Match her recognizable face, large brown eye, hair silhouette, colors, proportions, clean delicate dark outlines, and soft anime shading. Full body facing RIGHT in all frames. Transparent background with true alpha, no ground, no shadows, no captions, no borders, no grid lines.

Layout: exactly EIGHT separate full-body animation frames in an evenly spaced FOUR-column TWO-row sheet, read left to right then next row. Every cell equal size; generous transparent gutters; all heads same scale and same position relative to their cells; feet remain planted at exactly the same baseline in every cell. Fixed orthographic side view, no camera movement. Do not crop hair, shoes, hands, or mug. Entire character about 75 percent cell height.

Animate her taking ONE natural sip of coffee with her NEAR arm (the arm visible in the reference). Redraw this arm in its entirety in each frame. The previous hanging near arm and hand MUST NOT remain when the arm is bent: exactly TWO anatomically connected arms total, the far arm mostly hidden behind torso. No third arm, no duplicate dangling hand. Upper arm remains short, elbow close to lower ribs, forearm rotates around elbow, sleeve creases show the bend; no telescoping or stretching arm. Her fingers visibly grip the handle of one small white ceramic coffee mug, hand stays attached to wrist. Mug is held IN FRONT OF torso/face, never embedded in body.

Frames:
1. Relaxed holding: bent near elbow, forearm forward, mug upright in front of lower chest, hand gripping handle. Shoulder naturally attached to blue cardigan.
2. Begin lift: elbow bends more, hand and mug travel forward and upward in an arc, wrist neutral.
3. Approach: bent elbow clearly visible, mug raised close to mouth, visible hand supporting its handle.
4. Contact: cup rim touches lips; cup still nearly upright; shoulder-elbow-wrist forms an anatomically plausible folded arm, no straight diagonal stick.
5. SIP: rim remains at lips, wrist tilts mug approximately 20 degrees toward mouth, eye gently closes, slight subtle chin lift. Clearly distinct from frame 4.
6. End sip: eyes reopen, mug untips, moves slightly away from lips, elbow remains bent.
7. Lower: hand lowers along the same natural elbow arc toward chest.
8. Relaxed holding: return precisely to frame 1 pose to close a seamless loop.

Preserve head, hair, torso, legs and shoes registration as consistently as possible. This is a restrained standing animation; no walking, no outfit changes, no props other than a single small white mug. Anatomy and temporal consistency are critical.

Edit this eight-frame transparent sprite sheet. Keep the current character design, blue cardigan, cream trousers, white sneakers, right-facing side view, natural bent-arm coffee poses and four-column two-row layout. The animation anatomy is good. Make ONE targeted correction: animation registration and body consistency. Copy the exact same head size, hair silhouette, torso, trousers and shoe shapes from frame 1 into every cell at exactly the same cell-relative coordinates. Each cell is 384 x 512 in the 1536 x 1024 sheet. Keep hair top at cell y=23 and shoe sole at cell y=497. Keep the head center at the same x in each cell. Keep the same nose and mouth position in each cell; only the eyelid closes slightly in the sipping frame. No head growth, no body sway, no foot sliding, no row-dependent scaling. Do not change the established character's identity or proportion.

Only the near arm, sleeve bend, hand, and small white coffee mug change through these eight frames: chest-level holding, early lift, approach, lip contact, tilted sip, untilt/away, lowering, return exactly to chest-level holding of frame 1. The upper arm is attached to shoulder, elbow stays close to the side of ribs, forearm rotates toward mouth; fingers wrap the mug handle, wrist tilts the mug toward lips in frame 5. No additional dangling near arm. The cup rim must meet the lips, not the nose. Far arm remains mostly occluded behind torso. Show a clear mug handle under the gripping fingers if visible.

Genuinely transparent alpha background. No shadows, haze, text, grid lines or other objects. Preserve full bodies and equal grid cells.
